title: Descent of a retraction between fixed finitely presented models
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ have colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$ and finitely presented $F(i)$-modules $M,N$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Given $A$-linear maps $s:M_A\to N_A$ and $r:N_A\to M_A$ with $r\circ s=\mathrm{id}_{M_A}$, where $M_A=M\otimes_{F(i)}A$ and similarly for $N_A$, there exist $j\ge i$ and maps $s_j:M_j\to N_j$, $r_j:N_j\to M_j$ with $r_j\circ s_j=\mathrm{id}_{M_j}$ and an isomorphism $M_j\otimes_{F(j)}A\cong M_A$. Here $M_j=M\otimes_{F(i)}F(j)$ and similarly for $N_j$, with all scalar extensions along diagram or colimit maps.

source.place: Tag 0BC7, label more-algebra-lemma-colimit-perfect, first proof paragraph, using Algebra Tag 05N7 (2) and (3)

proof.text: Replace I by its antisymmetrization, transport F and the fixed stage models along the equivalence, and identify the colimits. A stage above the quotient class of i yields a stage above i after choosing representatives, since equivalence of indices means inequalities in both directions.

Apply the map clause of [lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent-affine] to s and r separately and extend both descended maps to a common upper stage. Scalar extension preserves finite presentation. The comparison isomorphisms of that clause agree with extendScalarsComp: both send 1 tensor m to 1 tensor (1 tensor m), and such tensors generate. Thus the base change of the composite of the descended maps is the identity.

Apply the equality clause of [lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent-affine] to that composite and the identity. At the resulting further stage functoriality gives the retraction identity. The extendScalarsComp comparison gives the required isomorphism for M. Transport back along the indexing equivalence and the colimit ring isomorphism.

theorem exists_retraction_model_of_directed_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F]
    (i : I) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i))
    (hM : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) M)
    (hN : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) N)
    (s : (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj M ⟶
      (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj N)
    (r : (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj N ⟶
      (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj M)
    (hsr : s ≫ r = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      let E := extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom
      ∃ (s' : E.obj M ⟶ E.obj N) (r' : E.obj N ⟶ E.obj M),
        s' ≫ r' = 𝟙 _ ∧
        Nonempty ((extendScalars (colimit.ι F j).hom).obj (E.obj M) ≅
          (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj M)
